ISO-8601: week 1 is the week containing the year's first Thursday.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick any date.
  2. Press Calculate.
  3. Read the ISO-8601 week number and week-year.
  4. See the weekday, day of year, quarter and days remaining.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the ISO week computed?

The Thursday rule: the week containing the first Thursday of the year is week 1. This correctly handles years where Jan 1 falls in the previous year's last week.

Can a year have 53 weeks?

Yes — about 71% of years have 52 weeks, the rest have 53. The tool returns the week-year too, which can differ from the calendar year near Jan 1.

Why does Jan 1 sometimes show last year's week?

Yes — the returned week-year is the year the ISO week belongs to, which near New Year can differ from the date's calendar year.
